description: Search public LinkedIn posts by keyword or hashtag, or enrich specific post URLs. No LinkedIn cookie or login is needed.

authorType.description: Keep only posts written by a person or by a company page. Applied after each post is opened, so a post whose author type cannot be determined is kept.
authorType.title: Author Type

contentType.description: Keep only these post types: articles (LinkedIn articles), posts (text/reposts/polls/events), documents (PDF/PPTX document cards), videos, images.
contentType.title: Content Types

countryCode.description: Prefer LinkedIn posts indexed on this country's LinkedIn domain (site:xx.linkedin.com). 'auto' uses linkedin.com worldwide.
countryCode.title: Country

datePosted.description: Only keep posts from this time window.
datePosted.title: Date Posted

emitNoResultsMarker.description: When enabled and a clean search finds nothing, push one marker record ({searchQuery, noResults: true}) so zero matches can be told apart from a failed run.
emitNoResultsMarker.title: Emit No-Results Marker

enrichSdui.description: Use LinkedIn's anonymous public guest session (an ephemeral cookie issued by the site, like a normal browser) to read the richer public post layout. This adds reaction-type breakdowns, up to ~18 comments with profile links, and repost counts when available. No user account or credentials are involved.
enrichSdui.title: Enrich From Public Guest Session

excludeReposts.description: When enabled, skip posts that repeat someone else's content.
excludeReposts.title: Exclude Reposts

hydratePosts.description: When enabled, each found post is opened so the record carries the full text, author, date, engagement counts and top comments. Turn off for faster runs with link + snippet only.
hydratePosts.title: Open Each Post Page

includeDocumentDetails.description: For document (PDF/PPTX) posts, also fetch the per-page transcript and page-image URLs in addition to the document URL and page count.
includeDocumentDetails.title: Include Document Details

includeRepostCounts.description: Last-resort fallback: if the richer public guest layout was not obtained for a post, retry a few more times to catch the repost/share counts. Normally unnecessary when the guest session is active.
includeRepostCounts.title: Include Repost Counts

includeUnmatched.description: When enabled, posts that do not show every word of your query are also returned, marked keywordMatch: false. Useful for hashtags.
includeUnmatched.title: Also Return Loose Matches

includeVideoTranscript.description: When enabled and a video post exposes a transcript on its public page, the transcript is added to the record.
includeVideoTranscript.title: Include Video Transcripts

language.description: Preferred interface language used when opening each post page (affects LinkedIn's rendered text).
language.title: Language

maxResults.description: Maximum number of posts to return per run, after filters. The search index holds fewer posts for narrow queries.
maxResults.title: Max Results

mentions.description: Additional words added to every search query, for example a company or person name.
mentions.title: Extra Search Terms

mentionsCompany.description: Company name added to the search query. Numeric LinkedIn IDs cannot be used without a session and are ignored (a note is added to the run status).
mentionsCompany.title: Mentions Company

mentionsPerson.description: Person name added to the search query. Numeric LinkedIn IDs cannot be used without a session and are ignored (a note is added to the run status).
mentionsPerson.title: Mentions Person

minComments.description: Keep only posts with at least this many comments. Posts whose comment count is unknown are skipped when this is above 0.
minComments.title: Minimum Comments

minReactions.description: Keep only posts with at least this many reactions. Posts whose reaction count is unknown are skipped when this is above 0.
minReactions.title: Minimum Reactions

mode.description: What to run. 'auto' searches when searchQuery/searchQueries are set and enriches when postUrls are set (both can run together).
mode.title: Mode

monitorMode.description: When enabled, only posts that were not delivered by an earlier run with the same input are returned. Ideal for schedules.
monitorMode.title: Monitor Mode (only new posts)

postUrls.description: LinkedIn post or article URLs to enrich directly (activity, share, ugcPost, feed/update, /pulse/ links and country subdomains). (mode=postUrls/auto)
postUrls.title: Post URLs

postedAfter.description: Only keep posts published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to disable.
postedAfter.title: Posted After

postedBefore.description: Only keep posts published on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Leave empty to disable.
postedBefore.title: Posted Before

searchQueries.description: Additional queries to run in the same run; each is searched independently, duplicates are delivered once. Combine with Search Query. (mode=search/auto)
searchQueries.title: Search Queries (batch)

searchQuery.description: Keyword, phrase, or hashtag to find in public LinkedIn posts. Examples: 'artificial intelligence', '"product launch"', '#MachineLearning'. (mode=search/auto)
searchQuery.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: How to order the posts that were found. 'relevance' keeps the search engine's order; 'recency' sorts the found posts by date (newest first).
sortBy.title: Sort By

talksAbout.description: Topics or hashtags added to the search query; each value becomes #topic. Values with a leading # are accepted as-is.
talksAbout.title: Talks About (Topics / Hashtags)

title: LinkedIn Keyword & Hashtag Post Discovery Scraper Input
